shortDescription: Write a program to batch-call tools: the whole loop runs in one call, the model only sees the reduced result
longDescription: PTC (Programmable Tool Calling) turns repetitive mechanical fan-out into a TypeScript program: the model calls ptc_run_code once, the program runs the whole batch in loops or parallel with the read/write/edit/grep/glob toolset, and only one reduced result comes back to the context - no more walls of raw tool output. Ships with web_ds_search (search/open/find) for web evidence gathering, which can also be batched inside a program. Includes a /batch slash command and the ptc skill loaded automatically at session start; a gate nudges you toward batching when the same tool shape is called repeatedly. Open source at https://github.com/a1121611810/pi-ptc-subagents, released continuously via GitHub Releases.
